title: Intelectron letterhead in Beardsley Graham's Berkeley archive

tellings.quote: And in his archives at Berkeley there was like a a couple documents that had, you know, Intelectron letterhead

plain: Greg Malatzi, a researcher, says that the papers of a scientist named Beardsley Graham, kept in archives at Berkeley in California, include a couple of documents from the 1960s printed on the letterhead of a company called Intelectron. He tells it on a podcast episode about a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council. If true, it would tie Graham to that company and the circle around that story.
